charts.title: Participation rate in sports and physical exercise in Japan in 2023, by type of activity
charts.short: Sport participation rate in Japan 2023, by type of activity
charts.description: In a survey conducted in November 2023 in Japan, around 61 percent of respondents stated that they had walked for physical exercise purposes. Walking was the most prevalent activity engaged in as a physical exercise, followed by gymnastics (calisthenics), and working out. According to the survey data, the majority of respondents engaged in individual sports that are free to do, such as walking and gymnastics.
charts.note: Japan; November 7 to 27, 2023; 40,000 respondents; 18-79 years; multiple answers possible; physical activities that the respondents participated in within the last year; leading 15 activities
charts.source: Japan Sports Agency; MEXT (Japan); SRC (Japan) Participation rate
categories: Walking (including walking, strolling, walk to the train station, etc.)
Mountain climbing, trekking, trail running, rock climbing

charts.short: Number of sports club members in Japan 2014-2023
charts.description: In 2023, Japan had approximately 2.8 million fitness club members. The figure increased compared to the last year. Roughly one-third of subscribers were affiliated with schools. The gym membership penetration rate in Japan hovered under the five percent mark.
